what: On hover, an accent-color sheet, folded flat at -80° from the top-left corner (width 0), unfolds in .4s and tints the photo with multiply — on release it folds back the same way. Photo grid cells react one at a time as if an orange filter were applied

options.--fx-skew: Tilt when laid down folded, default -80deg
options.--fx-blend: Blend mode, default multiply — screen works better for a dark skin

note: ::after is used as the curtain — it overlaps if the element it is attached to already has another ::after. It does not unfold on touch devices (no hover) (the original also turns the curtain off on phone)

from.where: index.html .a3-visual photo slot · video slot — original archive.css .visual__inner a:after (scaleX(0) skewX(-80deg) → scaleX(1) skewX(0), transition all .4s, mix-blend-mode multiply, #ff5000)
